$canPackageOnBun.description: Returns whether a target is one Bun cannot compile itself (32-bit or legacy), so Graak is the way to build it

$isTargetSupported.description: Returns whether Graak builds a target for the given or detected package manager

$packageManager.description: Returns the package manager or runtime the project uses (bun, pnpm, npm, yarn)

$packagerType.description: Returns the default build strategy of a target: native when it runs on the Graak native host, otherwise sea when an official Node.js runtime is downloadable, portable if not

$supportedTargets.description: Returns the targets Graak builds for a package manager

packageManager.description: Package manager (bun, pnpm, npm, yarn), detected from the project when empty

$binaryArchitecture.description: Returns the CPU architecture of a target (x86, x64, armv7, arm64)

$binaryExtension.description: Returns the executable file extension of a target (.exe for Windows, empty otherwise)

$binaryFormat.description: Returns the executable format of a target (elf32, elf64, pe32, pe32plus, macho)

$is32BitOrLegacy.description: Returns whether a target is 32-bit (iSH, x86, ARMv7) or legacy Windows (7 / Vista)

$is32BitTarget.description: Returns whether a target uses a 32-bit CPU architecture

$is64BitTarget.description: Returns whether a target uses a 64-bit CPU architecture

$isArmTarget.description: Returns whether a target uses an ARM CPU (armv7 or arm64)

$isIsh.description: Returns whether a target is the 32-bit iSH emulator on iOS

$isLegacyWindows.description: Returns whether a target is legacy Windows (7 / Vista)

$targetBits.description: Returns the bitness of a target (32 or 64)

$targetDescription.description: Returns the human-readable description of a target

$targetName.description: Returns the display name of a target

$targetPlatform.description: Returns the operating system family of a target (ios-ish, windows-legacy, windows, linux, darwin, freebsd)
